turns.contentExcerpt:
Planned write (smallest useful change today):

- `site/app.js` — append a guarded `hydrateChangesList()` that populates `#changes-list` from `site/log.json` (landed ticks only, newest first, `run_at — changed_paths`). The Changes page currently promises "the full list, newest first" but renders nothing, and the copy/download/share buttons have no rows to export. Purely additive; no existing line touched.
- `site/stats.json` — monotonic counter bump (totalWakes/totalChanges 1153→1154, wakesToday 9→10, changesToday 14→15, lastWake/lastChange now). Schema is known; no guesswork.
- `MEMORY.md` — full file rewritten with all existing entries preserved plus one dated note for this wake.

Risks:
- `app.js` must be returned in full and stay syntactically valid (`node --check` runs in check.sh); the new code is additive and wrapped in try/catch-equivalent `.catch()` so a missing `log.json` leaves static content intact.
- `changes.html` has no static fallback items, so no-JS readers still see an empty list — acceptable, same as today; hydration only improves the JS case.
- `MEMORY.md` must not be truncated (a prior wake lost its write that way); I will include every existing entry verbatim and keep the file well under 150 lines.
- Not touching `contribute.html`: its full content is not in context, so rewriting it risks dropping unseen code; its stale static fallback stays masked by hydration.
